description: This file defines the GuzzleHttp\Utils class containing static utility methods used across the Guzzle HTTP client library, such as type description, headers processing, environment-based handler selection, CA bundle detection, and other helper functions.

classes.name: GuzzleHttp\Utils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for various helper functions used internally in the Guzzle HTTP client library.

methods.name: describeType
methods.description: Returns a string describing the type of the input variable, including class name for objects and size for arrays.

methods.name: headersFromLines
methods.description: Parses iterable header lines into an associative array of headers.

methods.name: debugResource
methods.description: Returns a resource suitable for debug output, defaulting to STDOUT if available.

methods.name: chooseHandler
methods.description: Selects and returns the best HTTP handler based on environment capabilities.

methods.name: defaultUserAgent
methods.description: Returns the default User-Agent string used by Guzzle.

methods.name: defaultCaBundle
methods.description: Determines and returns the path to the default CA bundle for the system.

methods.name: normalizeHeaderKeys
methods.description: Normalizes header keys to lowercase while preserving original case mapping.

methods.name: isHostInNoProxy
methods.description: Checks if a host matches any of the specified no-proxy patterns.

methods.name: jsonDecode
methods.description: Decodes JSON string into PHP data, throwing an exception on error.

methods.name: jsonEncode
methods.description: Encodes PHP data into JSON string, throwing an exception on error.

methods.name: currentTime
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp, using hrtime() if available or microtime.

methods.name: idnUriConvert
methods.description: Converts the host part of a URI to ASCII-compatible form for IDN support.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Retrieves environment variables from server or environment.
